label: Bird
description: Bird subjects — flight mechanics and plumage behavior a field guide would confirm.

items.name: golden-eagle
items.text: a golden eagle banking hard, splayed primary feathers spilling air like fingers, bronze nape catching the low light

items.name: snowy-owl
items.text: a snowy owl gliding a wing-length above drifted snow, comb-fringed flight feathers erasing every sound, yellow eyes fixed ahead

items.name: hummingbird
items.text: a hummingbird pinned motionless at a trumpet bloom, wings a figure-eight blur ring, iridescent gorget igniting at one exact angle

items.name: kingfisher
items.text: a kingfisher spearing the surface in a crown of spray, wings swept into a teardrop, electric-blue back the last thing to submerge

items.name: peacock
items.text: a peacock with its train fanned and shivering, eyespots rattling on their quills, iridescence rolling from green to bronze as it turns

items.name: flamingo-flock
items.text: a flamingo flock mirrored in still shallows, some asleep on one leg, others feeding head-down with bills upside down and sweeping

items.name: raven
items.text: a raven on a weathered fencepost, throat hackles flared, head cocked to aim one eye at the lens, plumage running oil-slick purple

items.name: puffin
items.text: a puffin with a dozen silver sand eels held crosswise in its parti-colored bill, wings still whirring from the landing

items.name: murmuration
items.text: a starling murmuration folding and shearing across the sky in one dark ribbon, density waves rippling through thousands of birds

items.name: heron
items.text: a grey heron statue-still among golden reeds, neck coiled into its shoulders in a loaded S, one eye angled at the water

items.name: macaw-pair
items.text: a scarlet macaw pair perched close on a rainforest snag, heads bowed together, one gently preening the other's nape feathers

items.name: swan-takeoff
items.text: a mute swan running across the water into takeoff, each slapping footstep leaving a ring, wingbeats throwing sheets of spray

items.name: wandering-albatross
items.text: a wandering albatross locked in dynamic soaring, three-meter wings never once beating, wingtip millimeters off the face of a swell

items.name: osprey-strike
items.text: an osprey hitting the water talons-first, wings thrown back, outer toes swiveled around to cage the fish beneath the splash

items.name: shoebill
items.text: a shoebill standing motionless in papyrus shallows, staring down its huge clog-shaped bill, waiting out a lungfish

items.name: secretary-bird
items.text: a secretary bird mid-stomp on a snake, black crest quills erect, one long scaled leg delivering the hammer strike

items.name: great-grey-owl
items.text: a great grey owl punching feet-first through unbroken snow crust, wings raised high, guided by hearing alone to the vole beneath

items.name: quetzal
items.text: a resplendent quetzal launching from a mossy nest hole, meter-long emerald tail streamers drawing slow calligraphy behind it

items.name: peregrine-stoop
items.text: a peregrine falcon folded into a full stoop, wings tucked to an anchor shape, third eyelids drawn across its eyes against the wind of a three-hundred-kilometer dive

items.name: crane-dance
items.text: red-crowned cranes dancing on packed snow, bows and vertical leaps mirrored between the pair, black secondaries flared against the white field

items.name: bird-of-paradise
items.text: a superb bird-of-paradise snapped into display, black cape and iridescent blue breast shield spread into a bouncing oval around the unimpressed brown female

items.name: emperor-huddle
items.text: emperor penguins packed into a huddle against the midwinter blizzard, the windward birds peeling off to rejoin at the sheltered side in one slow rotation, chicks balanced on their parents' feet
